investigation.waveWarning: CLEANUP WAVE IN {seconds}s: {count} item(s) will burn
investigation.tutorialBody:
Tap a highlighted spot to inspect it, then Log the clue.
Cleanup waves burn parts of the scene. Watch the warnings.
On the Timeline Board, drag logged clues into the order things happened.
Use the Preserve tab to secretly keep a few items. They will not burn.
Don't linger, and don't look too interested. The crew is watching.

timeline.trayLabel: Logged clues: drag into a slot. Drag back here to remove.
timeline.preserveHint: Tap an item to slip it into your bag. Tap again to put it back.
timeline.noSlots: No slots left. Put something back first.
timeline.emptyPreserve: Nothing left to save. Log clues before they burn.
